obligations.why: § 2 says Article 12 of Regulation (EU) No 1284/2009, on which the old text rested, does not apply in Norway. A duty to inform DEKSA that does apply is Article 10(1) of the regulation (Annex A to the forskrift): a credit to a frozen account is reported immediately.

summaries.en: A bank may credit a frozen account with funds a third party transfers to a person, entity or body listed in Annex II of Regulation (EU) No 1284/2009 only if the amounts credited are frozen too, and must then inform Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner (DEKSA), which § 2 names as the competent authority, of the transaction immediately. The regulation's general duty to report frozen accounts and amounts, Article 12, does not apply in Norway: § 2 lists it among the articles that are internal to the EU.

titles.en: Tell DEKSA immediately when a frozen account under the Republic of Guinea sanctions is credited with funds a third party transfers
